name: Native Select
summary: A plain select, styled with appearance: none and a CSS caret. The better default on a phone, where it opens the OS picker — reach for the Dropdown only when you need styled rows.
demoNote: No JavaScript on this page. Open one on a phone and you get the OS picker: full height, scrollable, with the platform's own screen reader behavior. That is the thing a custom listbox gives up.

contract.useWhen: The native select, which is the better default on a phone.
keyboard: native: the OS picker owns all of it
states: invalid — aria-invalid=true on the control, set only while the error shows
failureModes: appearance:none with no caret drawn back, leaving a box that does not look openable
a custom listbox reached for when this would have done
the label replaced by a first option reading "Choose…", which is a value, not a name
options styled beyond color, which the OS picker ignores anyway
